Article 4.3: FFN Institution Rules

Warren's summary

# Summary: FFN Institution Rules

The FFN Institution is a live trading program for traders who demonstrate successful performance in the Sim Funded program and pass a Promotion Review consisting of a Trading Performance Review and 1:1 Risk Interview. Promoted traders begin with $3,000 of real FFN capital, earn a 90% profit share with a $0 initial Maximum Loss Limit, and can scale capital through profit reinvestment, live performance milestones up to $10,000 at $500,000 cumulative profit, and discretionary FFN allocation. Institution accounts require intraday trading only with all positions closed by 4:44 PM ET, use standardized day-trading margin rates by product, and eligible payout requests submitted before the daily cutoff are processed the same business day subject to the account's Permanent Risk Buffer established at the first payout as $3,000 plus 50% of remaining live profit.

Program Overview

The FFN Institution is Funded Futures Network's live trading program.

Traders who demonstrate successful performance within FFN's Sim Funded program may become eligible for a Promotion Review. Traders selected for promotion receive an allocation of real FFN capital in a live brokerage account.

Simulated performance determines eligibility for consideration. It does not determine the amount of live capital allocated.

All traders promoted to the Institution begin with the same initial FFN capital allocation and may earn additional capital based on live performance.

Promotion Review

A Promotion Review is triggered when either of the following occurs:

A trader requests their 4th payout from a single Sim Funded account; or
A trader reaches 10 total payouts since their previous Promotion Review.

When a Promotion Review is triggered, all Sim Funded accounts held by the trader are closed, regardless of the outcome of the Promotion Review. Evaluations stay open (see Article 5.2).

Any payout that triggered the Promotion Review remains subject to the applicable Sim Funded payout rules.

Following the Promotion Review, the trader's payout count toward any future Promotion Review resets to zero.

Promotion Review Process

The Promotion Review consists of two components.

Trading Performance Review

The FFN Risk Team reviews the trader's historical performance, including factors such as:

Profitability
Drawdown
Position sizing
Trading frequency
Consistency
Markets traded
Trading behavior
Risk-adjusted performance
Overall risk profile

No single metric guarantees promotion.

1:1 Risk Interview

The trader will complete a one-on-one interview with an FFN Live Risk Manager.

The interview may cover the trader's strategy, preferred markets, typical position sizing, holding periods, approach to drawdowns, risk controls, trading schedule, market conditions, and other information relevant to FFN's decision to deploy company capital.

The Risk Interview is an internal FFN capital-allocation process. It is not investment advice, trading advice, or individualized financial advice.

Promotion Review Outcomes

Every Promotion Review results in one of three outcomes.

Promoted to the Institution

The trader receives an FFN live account funded with an initial $3,000 of real FFN capital.

Approved for Promotion, Trader Declines

A trader who is approved for the Institution may decline promotion.

The trader will receive an additional $1,000 transition payout and may immediately restart from the beginning of the FFN evaluation process.

Declining promotion does not prevent the trader from qualifying for a future Promotion Review.

Not Promoted

A trader who is not selected for the Institution may immediately restart from the beginning of the FFN evaluation process.

No additional $1,000 transition payout applies.

Sim Funded Accounts Close in Every Outcome

All existing Sim Funded accounts close when a Promotion Review occurs, regardless of the outcome.

Promotion does not preserve Sim Funded accounts.
Declining promotion does not preserve Sim Funded accounts.
Not being selected does not preserve Sim Funded accounts.
Initial Live Capital

Every trader promoted to the Institution begins with:

Institution Account	At Promotion
Initial FFN capital	$3,000
Initial Maximum Loss Limit (MLL)	$0
Trader profit share	90%
FFN profit share	10%
Eligible payout processing	Same business day
Overnight positions	Not permitted

The initial $3,000 is real capital owned and provided by FFN.

FFN capital is not trader profit and cannot be withdrawn by the trader.

Simulated balances and accumulated Sim profits do not transfer dollar for dollar into the live account.

Live Profit Split

Net eligible live trading profits are allocated 90% to the trader and 10% to FFN.

The trader's 90% share is eligible for payout subject to these rules.

FFN's 10% share remains FFN property. Rather than withdrawing its share from the account, FFN will generally retain that capital in the trader's live account as additional FFN risk capital.

FFN-retained capital is not withdrawable by the trader.

Same-Day Payouts

Eligible Institution payout requests submitted before FFN's published daily processing cutoff will be processed the same business day.

Payouts are subject to the 90/10 profit split and applicable Permanent Risk Buffer requirements.

There is no recurring minimum number of trading days between otherwise eligible Institution payouts.

Maximum Loss Limit Before First Payout

Every Institution account begins with an MLL of $0.

The MLL does not trail before the trader's first live payout.

Live Balance	MLL
$3,000	$0
$5,000	$0
$10,000	$0
$25,000	$0

The trader may accumulate live profit before the first payout without causing the MLL to increase.

Permanent Risk Buffer

The trader's first live payout establishes the account's Permanent Risk Buffer.

The initial Permanent Risk Buffer equals $3,000 plus 50% of the live profit remaining in the account following the first payout.

Balance After First Payout	Profit Remaining Above $3,000	Initial Permanent Risk Buffer
$4,000	$1,000	$3,500
$5,500	$2,500	$4,250
$8,000	$5,000	$5,500
$13,000	$10,000	$8,000
$23,000	$20,000	$13,000
$53,000	$50,000	$28,000

The portion of the Permanent Risk Buffer established at the first payout remains fixed.

Additional FFN-owned capital subsequently retained or allocated to the account may increase the total risk capital supporting the account.

Maximum Loss Limit After First Payout

Following the first payout, the MLL trails the account's highest end-of-day (EOD) balance by the applicable Permanent Risk Buffer.

The MLL only moves upward when the account establishes a new EOD high. It does not move downward following a losing trading day.

For an account with a $7,500 Permanent Risk Buffer:

Highest EOD Balance	MLL
$10,000	$2,500
$15,000	$7,500
$25,000	$17,500
$40,000	$32,500

The MLL is calculated based on EOD highs but applies continuously during the trading session.

If account equity reaches the current MLL, the account is breached.

Eligible distributions are reflected in the account's high-water calculation so that an approved payout does not itself create an MLL breach.

Continuing Versus Final Payouts

A trader who wishes to continue trading in the Institution must maintain the account's required Permanent Risk Buffer.

A trader may elect to request an otherwise eligible payout that would leave insufficient capital to maintain the required buffer. In that circumstance, the payout will be treated as a Final Institution Payout.

Following settlement, the live account will be closed.

Capital Scaling

Institution traders may receive additional FFN capital through three mechanisms.

FFN Profit Reinvestment

FFN's 10% share of live profits may remain in the account as additional FFN-owned risk capital.

Live Performance Milestones

Traders may earn additional FFN capital based on cumulative live profitability:

Cumulative Live Profit	Total Milestone Capital Allocation
$10,000	$500
$25,000	$1,000
$50,000	$2,500
$100,000	$5,000
$250,000	$10,000
$500,000	Individual Capital Review

Milestone allocations are not cumulative. For example, reaching $50,000 in cumulative live profit results in a total milestone allocation of $2,500, not $500 + $1,000 + $2,500.

All milestone capital remains FFN property and is not withdrawable.

Discretionary Scaling

FFN may allocate additional capital or modify risk parameters at any time based on demonstrated live performance, consistency, strategy, risk management, capital efficiency, or portfolio considerations.

There is no predetermined maximum live capital allocation.

Institution Performance Ranking

FFN Institution traders may participate in the Institution Performance Ranking.

Rankings are based exclusively on live trading performance. Simulated performance does not contribute to Institution rankings.

Risk-Weighted Return

Institution traders are ranked based on Risk-Weighted Return rather than absolute dollar profit.

The purpose of Risk-Weighted Return is to recognize traders who generate strong returns relative to the amount of FFN capital and risk required to produce those returns.

FFN may consider measures including return, realized and unrealized drawdown, capital utilization, adverse excursion, volatility of returns, and other risk characteristics when calculating Risk-Weighted Return.

FFN will apply a standardized methodology across eligible Institution traders.

Monthly Top 10%

At the conclusion of each calendar month, the Top 10% of eligible Institution traders by Risk-Weighted Return receive an additional FFN Performance Allocation.

Top 10%: +$500 FFN capital
#1 ranked Institution trader: +$1,500 FFN capital

The #1 allocation replaces, rather than adds to, the standard Top 10% allocation for that month.

Performance Allocations are FFN-owned live capital and are not withdrawable.

FFN may establish minimum trading activity requirements for monthly ranking eligibility. Eligibility criteria and ranking methodology will be established before the applicable ranking period and will not be changed retroactively during that period.

Institution Leaderboard

FFN may publish a live Institution Leaderboard displaying information such as:

Institution rank
Risk-Weighted Return
Institution level
FFN capital allocation
Cumulative live profit
Top 10% finishes
Monthly wins
Live tenure

The leaderboard may reset monthly while maintaining each trader's historical Institution record.

Institution Levels

Institution Levels recognize the amount of real FFN capital a trader has earned the opportunity to manage.

FFN Capital Allocation	Institution Level
$3,000+	Associate Trader
$5,000+	Trader
$10,000+	Senior Trader
$25,000+	Principal Trader
$50,000+	Portfolio Trader

Institution Levels are recognition designations and do not independently modify these rules unless FFN expressly states otherwise. They cannot be purchased.

Live Buying Power

Institution buying power is based on the following day-trading margin rates.

Day-trading margin rates
Product Code	Product	Day-trading margin per contract
MES	Micro E-Mini S&P 500	$50.00
MNQ	Micro E-Mini Nasdaq 100	$100.00
MYM	Micro E-Mini Dow Jones	$50.00
M2K	Micro E-Mini Russell 2000	$50.00

YM	E-Mini Dow Jones	$500.00
RTY	E-Mini Russell 2000	$500.00

Institution buying power is subject to FFN risk controls.

FFN may establish lower position limits or otherwise restrict available buying power based on individual trader risk, account capital, strategy, volatility, market conditions, concentration, or aggregate Institution exposure.

Capital allocation does not guarantee unrestricted use of all available leverage.

Intraday Trading Requirement

Institution accounts are intraday accounts. Overnight positions are prohibited.

All positions must be closed before 4:44 PM ET.

If FFN or the broker is required to liquidate a position because the trader failed to close it by the cutoff, the Institution account is breached and closed.

Risk Management Authority

The Institution is managed as a portfolio of FFN capital.

FFN may take reasonable action necessary to manage individual or aggregate risk, including:

Reducing buying power
Restricting instruments
Restricting position size
Requiring positions to be reduced
Liquidating positions
Requiring a distribution
Increasing or decreasing FFN capital allocations
Closing a live account

Risk decisions may consider individual trading performance, market conditions, volatility, liquidity, correlated trader exposure, concentration, FFN's aggregate portfolio, or other legitimate risk-management considerations.

If FFN closes an otherwise compliant and profitable Institution account solely for portfolio-risk reasons, eligible trader profits remain payable under the applicable 90/10 split.

Account Breach

If account equity reaches the current MLL, the Institution account is breached and trading access ends.

Any remaining eligible live profit will be settled according to the 90/10 profit split.

FFN-owned capital, including starting capital, FFN's retained profit share, milestone allocations, leaderboard Performance Allocations, and discretionary capital allocations, remains property of FFN.

Simulated Balances and Institution Promotion

Simulated performance determines whether a trader earns consideration for real capital. It does not determine the amount of real capital allocated.

Every trader promoted to the Institution begins with the same $3,000 initial FFN capital allocation.

Additional FFN capital is earned through live performance, FFN profit reinvestment, performance milestones, monthly Risk-Weighted Return rankings, and discretionary Risk Desk allocations.

Trading Platform, Fees and Commissions
Institution accounts are live brokerage accounts with our FCM.
Institution accounts are traded in Onyx or directly with the broker.
Market data fees and commissions are paid from the Institution account balance.
Live Commissions and Fees

Live commissions, market data fees and other trading fees: TBD.

Rules Summary
Rule	FFN Institution
Promotion trigger	4th payout on one Sim Funded account, or 10 payouts since the last Promotion Review
Sim Funded accounts at the Promotion Review	All close, regardless of outcome
Risk Interview	Required, 1:1
Starting live capital	$3,000 of real FFN capital
Profit split	90% trader / 10% FFN
Payout processing	Same business day
Initial MLL	$0
MLL before the first payout	Does not trail
First payout	Establishes the Permanent Risk Buffer
FFN profit share	Retained as FFN-owned capital
Performance ranking	Risk-Weighted Return
Monthly performance award	Top 10% earn additional FFN capital
Scaling	Milestones, ranking and discretionary allocation
Overnight positions	Prohibited
Buying power	Day-trading margin rates, subject to FFN risk controls
Capital ceiling	None predetermined
